title: Broker Performance Remedy Schedule — RideLink Waiting Charge for Stranded Members
content:
When a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation pickup runs late, the alternative-ride allowance includes a charge for the time the member was left waiting, set by how late the pickup ran.

**Rule.** The waiting charge is worked out by how late the pickup ran, every late pickup being more than the level's late threshold past the pickup window: when the minutes late are at least three times the late threshold, the charge is the wait minute fare of 0.45 USD for every minute past the pickup window; when they are at least twice the late threshold but under three times it, the charge is the wait minute fare for every minute beyond the late threshold; when they are under twice the late threshold, the charge is the flat stranding charge of 8.00 USD.

The minutes late are the minutes past the pickup window recorded on the late pickup record.

## Thresholds by level

| Level | Late threshold (minutes) | Twice the threshold | Three times the threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 45 | 90 | 135 |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical late pickups on a level with a 30-minute late threshold:*

| Minutes late | Band | Waiting charge |
|---|---|---|
| 45 | Under 60 | 8.00 USD |
| 60 | 60 to under 90 | 30 minutes beyond the threshold at 0.45: 13.50 USD |
| 70 | 60 to under 90 | 40 minutes at 0.45: 18.00 USD |
| 90 | 90 or more | 90 minutes at 0.45: 40.50 USD |

*Hypothetical, RideLink Stretcher Van, 100 minutes late:* 100 is at least 90 but under 135, so the charge is 55 minutes beyond the 45-minute threshold at 0.45, that is 24.75 USD.
